human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Introduce a small evidence-linked GovernanceSignal model and deterministic rules only for production-proven patterns: validation failure/repeat failure, source-declared semantic failure, backend fallback/unavailable/context overflow, evidence inconsistency, scope/forbidden violation, and human review required. Dependency: 8013.project-decision-records.
human_pressure.why_now: Problem Discovery should aggregate real recurring governance conditions, not arbitrary dashboard labels.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Derive a bounded first set of governance signals from ExecutionProjection and evidence with explicit evidence refs.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8013.project-decision-records. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
contracts: Only documented signal rules may be emitted.
failure_semantics: Unsupported pattern yields no signal plus coverage/unknown state, not invented classification.

steps.title: Define signal shape
details: type, severity, subject, details, evidence_refs, rule_version.
Signal IDs deterministic per run/type/subject/evidence identity.

steps.title: Implement runtime/source-declared rules
details: backend_fallback, backend_unavailable/context_too_large where explicitly evidenced, coder_semantic_failure only when source evidence declares/deterministically proves the defined pattern.

steps.title: Implement review signal
details: Unknown never creates a fake clean signal.

acceptance: Each signal has one or more evidence refs.
Signal set is bounded to documented evidence-proven patterns.
No governance score or generalized model quality score is added.

must_check: No signal is based on LLM interpretation.
reject_if: Model quality is inferred from fallback.
Missing evidence is interpreted as clean.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
